rationale: C01 is the immediately preceding annual memorandum and supplies the child’s concrete drafting framework as well as extensive nearly verbatim language. Both open with campaign scale, participating health and welfare organizations, national agencies, fundraising totals, and the campaign period; then appoint George M. Humphrey to the same federal vice-chairmanship; request department-wide cooperation throughout the United States and its territories and possessions; prescribe employee solicitation, equitable unit goals, and installment collection; and close by encouraging generous giving through a single appeal. C18 and C15 are earlier members of the same recurring drafting lineage, but C01 is the clearest direct template.

shared_material.child_excerpt: To assure the leaders of United Community Campaigns of America, representing local Community Chests and United Funds, of the cooperation of the Federal Government, I have approved the appointment of the Honorable George M. Humphrey, Secretary of the Treasury, as Vice Chairman for the Federal Government of United Community Campaigns.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: To assure the leaders of United Community Campaigns of America, representing local Community Chests and United Funds, of the cooperation of the Federal Government, I have approved the appointment of the Honorable George M. Humphrey, Secretary of the Treasury, as Vice Chairman for the Federal Government of United Community Campaigns.
shared_material.explanation: This distinctive appointment provision is reproduced verbatim.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I am confident that you will extend the full cooperation of your Department in each community throughout the United States and its territories and possessions where it conducts its operations.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am confident that you will extend the full cooperation of your Department in each community throughout the United States and its territories and possessions where it conducts its operations.
shared_material.explanation: The nationwide cooperation instruction is identical.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Such cooperation should, under the new uniform Federal policy on fund raising, include the effective solicitation of all employees, the acceptance of equitable unit goals, and the setting up of an adequate collection method for the convenience of those who wish to make contributions on an installment basis.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Such cooperation should include the effective solicitation of all employees, the acceptance of equitable unit goals, and the setting up of an adequate collection method for the convenience of those who wish to make contributions on an installment basis.
shared_material.explanation: The child preserves the same three-part administrative machinery, adding only a reference to the new uniform federal policy.

shared_material.child_excerpt: It is my hope that all employees will give thoughtfully and generously to these campaigns.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: It is my hope that all employees will give generously—not because they must, but because they may—keeping in mind the wide variety and large number of organizations they will be supporting through their gifts to this single appeal.
shared_material.explanation: Both conclude with the same appeal for generous employee participation, while the child redistributes the single-appeal rationale into the preceding paragraph.
